validation.nameTooLong: The name can have at most 100 characters.
validation.descriptionTooLong: The description can have at most 1000 characters.
validation.slugInvalid: Use 3 to 32 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; start and end with a letter or digit.
validation.orgNameRequired: Enter a name with at most 200 characters.
validation.pathInvalid: Enter an absolute path below /etc/, /usr/local/etc/ or /opt/.
validation.modeInvalid: Enter four octal digits without special bits, for example 0644.
validation.ownerInvalid: Owner and group are lowercase user and group names.
validation.contentTooLarge: The content can have at most 64 KiB.
validation.unitInvalid: Enter a unit name ending in .service, .timer, .socket or .path.

problems.name_taken: An item with this name already exists.
problems.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
problems.upstream_unavailable: The identity provider is not reachable. The organization was saved and can be provisioned again.
problems.range_too_large: The time range may span at most 92 days.
problems.page_out_of_range: This page is too far back. Narrow the search or filters.

problems.domain_taken: One of these domains belongs to another organization.
problems.attribute_owned_upstream: This is managed by the upstream directory and cannot be changed in Paddock.
problems.invalid_command: A command is not allowed: use an absolute path with optional arguments, without ALL, !, # and the characters , : = \ ^ $ * ? [ ].

device.tamper_protected_file_changed: The device {target} found the protected file {file} changed

agent_release.artifact_uploaded: {actor} uploaded the {arch} binary of agent release {version}

agent_rollout.advanced: The rollout of agent {version} moved to {percent, number} % of the devices
agent_rollout.halted: The rollout of agent {version} was halted
agent_rollout.completed: The rollout of agent {version} was completed

profile_assignment.updated: {actor} changed the devices of an assignment of {profile}

local_admin.rotation_requested: {actor} requested a new local administrator password for {hostname}

agentReleases.title: Agent releases
agentReleases.uploadHint: Releases are built, signed and uploaded with make agent-release; start, halt and resume their rollouts here.
agentReleases.heading: Agent {version}
agentReleases.waveFacts: Wave {wave, number} of {waves, number} ({percent} % of the devices) since {since}
agentReleases.thresholdFacts: Each wave lasts at least {minutes, number} minutes; the rollout halts when {min, number} devices or {percent, number} % of the devices in the waves so far fail, whichever is more.
agentReleases.countFacts: {eligible, number} in the waves so far, {updated, number} updated, {failed, number} failed

start.label: Start rollout
start.title: Start the rollout?
start.confirm: Agent {version} will be offered to 1 %, 10 %, 50 % and finally all devices, one wave per day, and halts automatically when too many devices fail.

halt.label: Halt rollout
halt.title: Halt the rollout?
halt.confirm: No more devices will be offered agent {version}. Devices that already updated keep it.

resume.label: Resume rollout
resume.title: Resume the rollout?
resume.confirm: Agent {version} will be offered again to the devices of the current wave.

loginDenied.title: Access denied
loginDenied.not_authorized: Your account is not authorized for the Paddock portal. Ask your administrator to add you to exactly one Paddock administrator group.
loginDenied.login_failed: The sign-in could not be completed.

devices.title: Devices
devices.conflict: {resource} is defined by {count, plural, one {one more device group} other {# more device groups}}; the definition with the smallest ID applies.

approve.label: Approve
approve.title: Approve device
approve.confirm: Approve {hostname}? The device becomes active and receives its configuration.

reject.label: Reject
reject.title: Reject device
reject.confirm: Reject {hostname}? Its identity is revoked; the device has to enroll again.

release-quarantine.label: Release quarantine
release-quarantine.title: Release quarantine
release-quarantine.confirm: Release {hostname} from quarantine? Only do this when you are sure the identity was not cloned.

retire.label: Retire
retire.title: Retire device
retire.confirm: Retire {hostname}? Its identity is revoked permanently and it stops receiving configuration. This cannot be undone.

login.title: Login
login.agentTooOld: The agent on this device is too old for login management: logins and sudo rights are not managed until it is updated.
login.suspendedHint: Directory logins are suspended on this device. Break-glass accounts still work.
login.assignmentHint: Who may log in. Leave both empty to allow every user of the organization.

suspend.label: Suspend logins
suspend.title: Suspend logins
suspend.confirm: Suspend directory logins on {hostname}? Open sessions of directory users are ended at the device's next check-in.

sudo.title: Effective sudo rights
sudo.caption: Users allowed on this device with sudo rights
sudo.none: Nobody has sudo rights on this device.
sudo.rootEquivalent: {username} effectively has root on this device: {commands}
sudo.sudoRsLecture: Custom sudo lecture text is not supported by sudo-rs; users see the default lecture.

report.title: Latest reports of the agent
report.caption: The last login and sudo report the device sent

events.sudo_apply_failed: The sudo rights of {username} could not be applied: {message}
events.sudo_apply_failed_config: The sudo configuration failed its check: {message}
events.sudo_user_unresolved: {username} has sudo rights but is not known on the device yet

tokens.title: Enrollment tokens
tokens.revokeConfirm: Revoke the enrollment token {name}? Devices can no longer enroll with it.
tokens.shownOnce: This enrollment configuration contains the token. It is shown only now: copy it and distribute it like a password.

files.title: Managed files
files.deleteConfirm: Stop managing {name}? Devices keep the file as it is.
files.pathHint: Below /etc/, /usr/local/etc/ or /opt/; protected system paths are not allowed.

units.title: Managed units
units.deleteConfirm: Stop managing {name}? Devices keep the unit as it is.
units.wantedState: {enabled, select, true {enabled} other {disabled}}, {active, select, true {running} other {stopped}}

users.title: Users
users.usernameHint: Name and one of the organization's domains, for example dave@example.org.
users.usernameInvalid: Enter a username such as dave@example.org.
users.lockIncomplete: The lock is incomplete: Authentik has not confirmed it, so the user's sign-out may be missing. The user's devices refuse the user already.
users.linkShownOnce: Give this one-time link to {username}: it sets the password and is valid for 24 hours. It is shown only now.
users.syncedHint: This user is synced from an upstream directory: name, email and password are managed there. Lock, groups and permissions are managed here.
users.lockConfirm: Lock {username}? Online sign-ins fail at once, and the user's devices lock the sessions and refuse logins at their next check-in.
users.unlockConfirm: Unlock {username}? The user signs in with the device code again and sets up a new PIN.
users.deleteConfirm: Delete {username} with all group memberships and permissions? This cannot be undone.

userGroups.title: Groups
userGroups.slugHint: Part of the group name devices see; cannot be changed later.
userGroups.slugInvalid: Use 2 to 42 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; start and end with a letter or digit.
userGroups.importHint: Its members of this organization are copied every few minutes.
userGroups.deleteConfirm: Delete the group {name} with its login and permission assignments? This cannot be undone.
userGroups.mirrorHint: The members of this group are copied from the upstream directory and cannot be changed here.
userGroups.removeConfirm: Remove {username} from {group}? The user loses the group's logins and permissions.

profiles.title: Permission profiles

classHints.restricted: sudo for the listed commands only.

profiles.commandsHint: One absolute command per line, with optional arguments.
profiles.invalidProfile: These commands are no longer allowed: {commands}. Users it applies to get no sudo rights on their devices until you edit or remove these commands.
profiles.rootEquivalentProfile: These commands hand out root, on their own or together: {commands}. Devices treat this profile like full rights.
profiles.rootEquivalentEffective: The combined commands hand out root: {commands}. This is reported as full rights.
profiles.fullConfirm: Create {name} with full sudo rights? Everyone it is assigned to becomes root on their devices.
profiles.toFullConfirm: Give {name} full sudo rights? Everyone it is assigned to becomes root on their devices.
profiles.assignFullConfirm: Assign {name}, which grants full sudo rights? The subject becomes root on the devices in scope.
profiles.deleteConfirm: Delete {name}? Profiles that are still assigned cannot be deleted.
profiles.scalarFacts: Password asked: {password, select, true {yes} other {no}}; remembered for {timeout, number} min; lecture: {lecture}
profiles.unassignConfirm: Remove {name} from {subject}? The rights it granted are removed at the next bundle.

loginSettings.title: Login & privileges

sessionActions.terminate: End the user's sessions (unsaved work is lost)

loginSettings.sessionActionHint: What devices do with the open sessions of a locked user.
loginSettings.breakGlassHint: Local accounts, one per line, that Paddock never restricts.
loginSettings.allowlistHint: One file name per line; any other file there is moved away by the agent.
loginSettings.lectureHint: Shown by sudo according to each profile's lecture setting.
